purpose: Teach: 拳銃/失踪/濃縮/閉じ込め/荒廃/痴呆/損なわ/マルクス主義

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察、容疑者の拳銃所持を確認されましたね
lines.en: So the police have confirmed the suspect was carrying a firearm.
lines.style: Measured inquiry. Slight pause before speaking—thinking through the case. Clear enunciation on the key details. Respect for the process underlying the words, not performing intelligence.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、失踪者の捜索を継続します
lines.en: We're continuing the search for the missing person.
lines.style: Steady, professional. Each word carries equal weight. No rush. The tone of someone who has briefed superiors and now briefing civilians—clear without being patronizing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、濃縮された薬物の押収を警察、なさいましたね
lines.en: And the police recovered the concentrated drugs as evidence.
lines.style: Thoughtful confirmation. Small nod in the voice. Building on what's been said rather than interrogating. The rhythm of someone assembling a narrative piece by piece.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者を閉じ込めた現場を保全します
lines.en: We're preserving the site where the victim was held.
lines.style: Calm, definitive. Each clause lands without apology. The voice of procedural competence. Slight firmness on 「保全します」—commitment, not suggestion.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、荒廃した空き家での犯行を警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: So the police are investigating the abandoned building where the crime took place.
lines.style: Quiet respect underneath. Not a question despite the rising particle—acknowledgment of difficulty. Careful, deliberate pace. The voice of someone who understands what 「荒廃した空き家」 means for evidence recovery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、痴呆症の方が関わる事案にも配慮します
lines.en: We're also being mindful of cases involving individuals with dementia.
lines.style: Intentional shift—warmer without losing authority. This matters personally to him. Slight soften on 「配慮します」. Still official, but the humanity showing through the procedure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、被害者の名誉を損なわぬよう警察、配慮されてますね
lines.en: The police are being careful to protect the victim's dignity throughout this.
lines.style: Gentle affirmation. Not interrogating anymore—affirming. Slight warmth in the voice now. Recognition that this matters beyond investigation. Slower than before, with the weight of human concern underneath.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、マルクス主義系過激派の動向も注視します
lines.en: We're also monitoring the movements of Marxist extremist groups.
lines.style: Steady professional tone. Returns to procedural formality. No inflection change—treating this threat with the same measured competence as the others. Eye contact level unwavering.
